dedupeText: vibrant furry soundtrack cover iridescent furry texture gradient background 3d lettering neon colors tactile textured fur tufts radiating from a central point behind the main title high contrast relationship between the warm orange to pink gradient background and the cool iridescent text layered depth between the background the soft fur elements and the hard edged 3d typography visual weight concentrated in the center with a horizontal typographic anchor at the bottom combine a vibrant dual tone gradient background with a central explosion of multi colored tactile textures fur feathers topped with high gloss 3d prismatic typography and clean metadata footers

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, tactile composition featuring a central cluster of multi-colored, stylized tufts of fur in vibrant neon shades, overlaid with bold, 3D iridescent lettering that mimics the appearance of faceted gemstones or prismatic glass with a gold metallic border.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured fur tufts radiating from a central point behind the main title
High-contrast relationship between the warm orange-to-pink gradient background and the cool iridescent text
Layered depth between the background, the soft fur elements, and the hard-edged 3D typography
Visual weight concentrated in the center with a horizontal typographic anchor at the bottom
coreInvariants: Hyper-realistic fur textures in yellow, green, purple, and blue
Prismatic/iridescent internal texture within the primary 3D letters
Gold beveled edges on the main display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centered, occupying the middle third of the frame, surrounded by a halo of fur.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, 3D 'T' of the primary title acts as the primary anchor, supported by the horizontal line of text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright iridescent center, move outward to the textured fur, then drop to the script subtitle and finally the bottom metadata line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the clean gradient background on the left and right edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant pink and orange gradient background providing warmth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool iridescent blues, silvers, and purples within the 3D lettering.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright lime green and lemon yellow fur tufts for high-energy highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with high-value highlights on the metallic and prismatic surfaces.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif with custom flourishes
letterConstructionRules: Primary letters have a thick gold outer bevel
Internal faces feature a faceted, crystalline prismatic texture
The first letter features an exaggerated, sweeping top bar
Secondary script text is fluid and handwritten
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial capital has a wave-like extension on the crossbar
Lowercase 'l's are rendered as vertical prismatic pillars

anatomy.contrast: High (between gold edge and prismatic fill)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy 3D display type, organic script, and clean geometric sans-serif.

avoid: Flat 2D text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: To match the toy-like, high-production CGI aesthetic.
To provide an organic, energetic counterpoint to the rigid 3D text.
For the clean, legible metadata at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vibrant diagonal gradient background from hot pink (bottom left) to bright orange (top right). In the center, place a dense, radial cluster of soft, hyper-realistic fur tufts in neon green, electric purple, lemon yellow, and deep navy blue. The fur should look tactile and fluffy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D title in the center with a gold metallic bevel and a prismatic, iridescent crystalline face. Below it, add a white brush-style script subtitle at a slight angle. At the very bottom, add a single line of bold, all-caps geometric sans-serif text in white with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the fur texture highly detailed and multi-colored?
Does the main title have a visible 3D gold edge?
Is the background a smooth pink-to-orange gradient?
Is the bottom text perfectly centered and legible?

avoid: Flat, un-beveled text for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light interaction on the 3D letters
Ensure fur tufts appear to be behind the main title but in front of the background
Verify the iridescent texture has a rainbow-like color shift
Confirm the script text is legible against the textured background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vibrant dual-tone gradient background with a central 'explosion' of multi-colored tactile textures (fur/feathers), topped with high-gloss 3D prismatic typography and clean metadata footers.
